body.name: shared-sign fuzzy-hypothesis handle
body.construction: Tile \(\mathcal X\) at width \(h\) and \(\mathcal Y\) at width \(\delta\); attach one Rademacher propensity sign to each covariate cell, reuse that sign across all outcome cells, impose exact odd-bump normalization, mix the propensity signs, and compare neighboring outcome hypercube vertices through a full-sample Hellinger or chi-square calculation and Kantorovich--Rubinstein separation.
